caveat: Council-supplied VLGGC ABS1/ABS2-3 questionnaire return, not audited GPFS; provisional and unverified. Non-additive rows only; no cross-council total; never mixed with VGC1, vic-budget, ABS GFS, LGPRF, waste or NSW council data. Bendigo balance-sheet totals reconcile exactly to the GPFS; capital outlays carry a documented $473,353.20 accrual/cash bridge to the GPFS cash-flow payments.
unit: whole AUD (x100 cents); cells carry cents

reconciliation.bridge_note: ABS1 total capital outlays $56,221,353.20 vs audited GPFS cash-flow payments for capital assets $55,748k; difference $473,353.20 (0.85%) is an accrual/cash classification bridge and is documented, not forced to equality.

notes: Derived rows only; neither workbook is redistributed. The source Totals rows are suppressed and no cross-council total is emitted. Every row is non-additive agency detail, provisional/local_government and verified=false. Zero cells are not emitted. Balance-sheet asset-class labels are preserved only for ABS2 asset lines; ABS1 asset classes are in the asset_class field.
